scripts.build: pnpm build:host && pnpm build:extension && pnpm verify:build
scripts.build:host: tsc -p tsconfig.host.json && node scripts/build/stamp-host.mjs && node scripts/build-page.mjs
scripts.build:extension: node scripts/check-security-policy.mjs && node scripts/check-extension-boundaries.mjs && pnpm --filter @mitter/extension build
scripts.check: pnpm check:standards && pnpm format:check && pnpm check:protocol && pnpm check:bridge && pnpm check:terminal && pnpm check:ui && pnpm check:host && pnpm check:extension && pnpm check:scripts
scripts.check:host: tsc -p tsconfig.host.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/host/src/core/service/tsconfig.json && node --import ./packages/bridge/src/runner/test-source-loader.mjs --test --test-concurrency=1 apps/host/test/*.test.mjs apps/inference/test/*.test.mjs apps/host/src/core/service/*.test.mjs apps/host/src/core/quality/*.test.mjs apps/host/src/core/preview/*.test.mjs apps/host/src/core/dev-server/*.test.mjs apps/host/src/core/terminal-control/*.test.mjs
scripts.check:extension: pnpm --filter @mitter/extension typecheck && node --import ./packages/bridge/src/runner/test-source-loader.mjs --test apps/extension/test/transport/*.test.mjs && node apps/extension/test/ui/run.mjs && node scripts/check-security-policy.mjs && node scripts/check-extension-boundaries.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write "*.{json,md,yaml}" .prettierrc.json apps/extension apps/host apps/inference apps/site brand packages scripts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "*.{json,md,yaml}" .prettierrc.json apps/extension apps/host apps/inference apps/site brand packages scripts
scripts.check:bridge: tsc -p packages/bridge/tsconfig.json && node --import ./packages/bridge/src/runner/test-source-loader.mjs --test packages/bridge/src/**/*.test.mjs packages/bridge/src/support.test.mjs packages/bridge/src/dom/chat-dom.test.ts
